title: Reliable model integration baseline
description: Assess how you validate, secure, recover, and observe structured model output.

skills.title: Structured output validation
skills.remediation: Review the distinction between parsing JSON and validating its runtime shape.
skills.reviewPrompt: After JSON parsing succeeds, what must happen before model output becomes application data?
skills.reviewAnswer: Validate the runtime schema, field constraints, size, and destination safety before use.

skills.title: Bounded recovery
skills.remediation: Review retry eligibility, attempt limits, and explicit terminal failure.
skills.reviewPrompt: What keeps model-output recovery from becoming a reliability and cost failure?
skills.reviewAnswer: Retry only recoverable failures, cap total attempts, and return a typed terminal failure when exhausted.

skills.title: Output safety and authority
skills.remediation: Review safety checks and why models cannot authorize privileged actions.
skills.reviewPrompt: Which decisions must remain deterministic even when model output is structurally valid?
skills.reviewAnswer: Safety policy, authorization, and tool permissions remain deterministic and outside the model.

skills.title: Safe observability
skills.remediation: Review useful operational metadata and sensitive fields that should not be logged.
skills.reviewPrompt: Which signals diagnose output failures without recording model content?
skills.reviewAnswer: Track latency, attempts, failure category, token use, and terminal outcome without raw prompts or output.

activities.prompt: A model response parses as JSON. What should the application do next?
activities.rationale: Parsing establishes JSON syntax only. Runtime schema and field constraints still require deterministic validation.

choices.label: Validate the runtime schema and constraints
Ask the model whether its response is valid

activities.prompt: Which controls must remain deterministic? Select all that apply.
activities.rationale: Schema validation, safety policy, and authorization cannot be delegated to model judgment.

choices.label: The exact wording of a helpful explanation

activities.prompt: Put the output handling flow in order.
activities.rationale: Parse first, validate structure second, apply safety and policy controls third, then use the value.

activities.prompt: In one or two sentences, describe a safe retry policy for invalid model output.
activities.rationale: A safe policy limits total attempts and returns an explicit terminal failure when recovery is exhausted.

activities.prompt: Name useful failure signals and one category of data that should not be logged by default.
activities.rationale: Operational metadata can diagnose behavior without storing prompts, raw output, secrets, or sensitive retrieved data.
